links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading ease of chatbot versus AAO website answers to cataract FAQs
links.effect: Reading ease: Bard 55.5 ± 8.48, AAO 51.96 ± 12.46, Bing AI 41.77 ± 9.53, ChatGPT 34.38 ± 9.75 (p<0.001); ChatGPT and Bing AI were harder to read than the AAO website. Chatbots also scored lower on PEMAT understandability than the AAO website.
links.quote: Flesch-Kincaid readability ease analysis showed that Bard (55,5 ± 8,48) had the highest mean score, followed by AAO website (51,96 ± 12,46), Bing AI (41,77 ± 9,53), and ChatGPT (34,38 ± 9,75, (p < 0.001)).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates responses from commercial LLM chatbots (ChatGPT, Bard, Bing AI) against standard educational resources (AAO website) for cataract patient education using validated rubrics (SOLO, PEMAT, Flesch-Kincaid) without evaluating specific deployment guardrails.
